identity.description: An attacker executes an AppleScript through the command line to access credential files on macOS. Cortex detects this behavior as an uncommon AppleScript execution pattern. The attack involves using osascript to run a script that accesses keychain data.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon AppleScript Execution
biocs.description: Execution of osascript with unusual parameters or from unexpected locations
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'bash'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'zsh'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'sh'
